name: Seven club one count
chapter: Tricks in one count / Brolly notation

body.h: Imagine Ben juggling a five club cascade. Anne is standing on his shoulders holding one club in each hand. She drops a club from her left hand into Ben's pattern and steals a club, then she drops a club from her right hand into Ben's pattern and steals a red club. For Ben the pattern doesn't change. Now if Anne continuously replaces clubs in Ben's pattern like this, then Anne and Ben are passing seven clubs on one count.

This is probably what inspired Brendan Brolly to use the siteswap 5 to describe passing seven clubs on one count. Of course it also means you can work out tricks in seven club one count by thinking about five object siteswaps!
